title: Qualify versioned Math NuGet archives and independent local consumers
commitMessage: feat: qualify clean local Math NuGet archive and distribution contracts

contribution.summary: Qualify seven versioned local net10 Math archives with an independent bounded ZIP/nuspec audit, real SHA-256, embedded distribution README/NOTICE and a clean pinned NuGet consumer. Require a compiled missing-API RED, 40 GREEN tests, eight package-only probes, the retained eight-probe exact console and seven inspected archives. Record the observed host without claiming untested RIDs, public CI or stable 1.0. Complete C02-T1 only; keep C02, M5-W02 and M5 open.
contribution.value: Make independently consumable Math packages verifiable from actual local archive bytes, declared dependency versions, documented notices and isolated NuGet restores. Do not confuse a net10 target with cross-platform certification or a local preview with public publication.
debtChanges: Observe a genuinely compiled absent public MathLocalReleaseQualification API RED against qualified distribution preview.2 before adding the archive auditor.
Implement a bounded, non-extracting BCL ZIP/nuspec validator for the exact seven-product net10 graph; distinguish a declared manifest from inspection of real bytes.
Embed distribution README and ownership notices without selecting a license or implying that every preexisting dependency package already contains new documentation.
Falsify corrupt ZIPs, wrong IDs/versions, mismatched dependencies, invalid XML, missing net10 assembly/documents, ZIP traversal and resource budgets with 40 GREEN oracles.
Repack seven real local archives, inspect nuspec graph, readme/notice and SHA-256 independently, then compare all digests against a separate clean NuGet-only consumer.
Restore the new eight-probe consumer and rerun the existing exact eight-probe console using only the pinned local distribution preview.3 without source ProjectReference or external feeds.
Run locked Release compilation, focused distribution tests, relevant prior Math component regressions, native DWF and planning checks with proportional validation.
Record actual SDK/RID without certifying other OSs, public CI, stable NuGet, binary ABI, license choice or cross-platform support; leave C02-T2 and release gates open.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS076 success, qualify M5-W02-C02-T2 source/binary compatibility, native dependencies, resource limits and platform support evidence; defer stable/public release and untested operating systems.

achievements.achievement: Observe one compiled missing public bounded NuGet/archive qualification API RED on the previous qualified distribution package.
Qualify seven declared versioned Math archives, embedded distribution README/NOTICE and explicit archive refusal boundaries through 40 independent GREEN oracles.
Verify actual seven local NuGet archive SHA-256 against both independent inspector and eight-probe package-only consumer, and rerun the retained eight-probe console.
Complete a reproducible local net10 package and clean-consumer contract without closing C02, M5-W02 or M5 or claiming unobserved OS certification.
